name: atlas-platform
description: TypeScript-first app platform with focused SDK, runtime, static registry, generators and test tooling.

scripts.ci:affected: pnpm run typecheck:affected && pnpm run lint:affected && pnpm run test:affected
scripts.ci:full: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test
scripts.test:generated: pnpm run pack:verify && tsx scripts/verify-generated-projects.ts --package-manager=yarn && tsx scripts/verify-generated-projects.ts --package-manager=pnpm
scripts.test: turbo run test --concurrency=1 --filter="@atlas/*" && node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --config jest.config.json --roots scripts
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm --filter @atlas/cli run test:e2e && pnpm --filter @atlas/sdk run test:e2e && pnpm --filter @atlas/runtime run test:e2e && pnpm --filter @atlas-example/e2e run test:e2e
scripts.typecheck: turbo run typecheck --filter="@atlas/*" && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tooling.json
